title: Release 4.2 changelog
prompt:
Turn these notes into a changelog of at most 100 words.

Source: Version 4.2.0 adds csv export. It fixes a duplicate login bug. It removes the legacy api.

Use these exact markdown headings: ## Added, ## Fixed, ## Removed. Mention csv export, duplicate login, and legacy api. Do not write TODO.
constraints: Keeps csv export, duplicate login, and legacy api
